description: https server addresses for T4-02 item 8 (docs/specs/T4-02.md, D9, R10, R11). Read by packages/core/src/jellyfin/gateway-https-host.test.ts, by the device conformance run packages/core/src/conformance/server-address-conformance.ts and by the native client's HttpsHostAgreementTest.kt, so the core and the native client are judged against one fixed expectation. refused: the core refuses each before any request with its kind, and the native client refuses each as INVALID_ADDRESS. accepted: the core admits each and hands over serverUrl; the native client accepts the address as written and serverUrl, with serverUrl's host lower-cased. invalidPunycode: xn-- labels that are not valid punycode; the core admits each and hands over serverUrl, and the native client either refuses it as INVALID_ADDRESS or keeps the host exactly as written, lower-cased. Non-ASCII characters are written literally, so each vector reads as a viewer would type it; each vector's note names the character it exercises.

refused.note: with a port and a base path
